Embark on an unforgettable 10-day self-drive adventure through New Zealand's South Island, focusing on stunning landscapes and exhilarating outdoor activities. This itinerary is designed for two adults during December, offering a balance of scenic driving, hiking, and unique experiences. # 10-Day South Island Adventure Itinerary

This itinerary provides a daily plan to immerse yourselves in the natural beauty and adventure of the South Island.

## Day 1: Arrive in Queenstown
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive at Queenstown Airport (ZQN), pick up your rental car.
- **Afternoon:** Settle into your accommodation. Take the Skyline Gondola up Bob's Peak for panoramic views of Queenstown and Lake Wakatipu.
- **Food:** Enjoy dinner at a lakeside restaurant in Queenstown, savoring local produce.
Action: [Button: Explore Queenstown]: https://www.queenstownnz.co.nz/

## Day 2: Queenstown Adventure & Lake Wakatipu
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- **Morning:** Choose your adventure: options include jet boating on the Shotover River, bungee jumping (Kawarau Bridge), or a scenic cruise on Lake Wakatipu.
- **Afternoon:** Explore the Queenstown Gardens or take a leisurely hike along one of the many trails, such as the Queenstown Trail for stunning lake views.
- **Food:** Casual dinner at a local pub in Queenstown.

## Day 3: Milford Sound Scenic Day Trip
Media: Image=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Milford_Sound_Panorama.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Embark on a full-day guided bus tour from Queenstown to Milford Sound, including a scenic cruise. The drive itself is spectacular, passing through Te Anau and the Eglinton Valley.
- **Afternoon:** Experience the awe-inspiring fiord, with waterfalls cascading down sheer cliffs and wildlife sightings.
- **Food:** Lunch is typically included on the cruise; enjoy dinner back in Queenstown.
Action: [Button: Book Milford Sound Tour]: https://www.milford-sound.co.nz/

## Day 4: Queenstown to Wanaka via Crown Range
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/car-front.svg
- **Morning:** Drive from Queenstown to Wanaka via the scenic Crown Range Road (allow for stops at viewpoints). This is New Zealand's highest main road.
- **Afternoon:** Arrive in Wanaka, check into your accommodation. Explore the lakefront and visit the iconic "That Wanaka Tree".
- **Food:** Dinner at one of Wanaka's charming cafes or restaurants.

## Day 5: Wanaka Exploration & Hiking
